sentence: over the shoulder of our hero running, sword drawn, the full urban alleyway rushing by.
note: The single source of truth for the bake-off. All three paths (SceneCraft / Three.js / Blender-MCP) consume THIS file. Coordinates: Z up, metres; the alley recedes along +Y; the camera looks down +Y from behind the hero. This is the staging-AI's actual output: language resolved onto a curated vocabulary, with everything it will not fake moved to `flagged`.

camera.comment: Over-the-shoulder is authored as an on-screen-layout constraint, NOT absolute coords (declarative-camera). The solver places the camera so two screen anchors land: the hero's near shoulder in the lower-left foreground, and the alley's vanishing point just right of centre.

upper_body_overlay.comment: run drives the lower body + counter-swing left arm; sword_drawn overrides the right arm, masked at the spine — the pose-blend the brief asks us to test.

motion.comment: The staging fixes the forward motion VECTOR (subject + apparent world flow down -Y past camera). The TREATMENT ('rushing by': speed-lines / motion-blur / blur amount) is deliberately NOT set here — it is the flow-field spine + render's job. Staging hands the render a vector, not a look.
motion.couples_to: The Flow Field is the Spine

flagged.why: Which kit / architecture style / material era (brick vs concrete, wet vs dry, signage, era) is an art-direction call, not a staging fact. Greybox facades placed; real kit (KitBash3D Cargo / Poly Haven CC0) is a deliberate later import. The stager refuses to invent a look.
Needs a real Mixamo run-cycle FBX (Adobe login) + a chosen phase. Staged as ONE representative mid-stride pose; the gait fidelity + frame phase are flagged for the locomotion import.
Speed / motion-blur / speed-lines belong to the flow-field spine + render, not staging. Staging sets the vector; the look is downstream.
Who the hero IS (face, costume, palette) lives in IP-Adapter / per-character LoRA at render time, not in the block. Staging blocks an anonymous proxy.

acceptance: A correct decomposition resolves camera-grammar + locomotion + pose-overlay + environment-layout onto the curated vocabulary, and FLAGS asset-kit, clip-fidelity, motion-treatment, and identity rather than faking them. The block must land as a hand-editable Blender scene.
